name: Ricardo Huamán
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While working as a mechanic in Lima, a local racing team sought his expertise in engine tuning. His meticulous approach quickly impressed them, leading to his involvement in national racing series. Ricardo's sharp eye for detail and practical solutions propelled him through the ranks, eventually specializing in vehicle dynamics and race strategy.

As a chief engineer, Ricardo prioritizes a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute. He is known for his ability to quickly diagnose problems and implement effective solutions under pressure. His approach is characterized by a blend of proven techniques and a willingness to adapt to new technologies.

Ricardo's distinctive trait lies in his uncanny ability to predict track conditions and adjust car setups accordingly. He has a reputation for pushing the boundaries of what's possible with limited resources, making him a valuable asset to any racing team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave on top.
physical.description: Ricardo is of medium build with a serious but kind face.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on his leg when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking mate cocido before every race.
